RIDE BIKE WALK PARK Bus Avon Transit makes getting around Avon for work or recreation easy and convenient, offering fare-free bus and gondola service funded by the town’s general revenue fund. Use the downtownerapp to see real-time bus locations! Local routes allow you to park once and access shops, restaurants, and attractions like the Avon Recreation Center, Harry A. Nottingham Park, and the public library. Buses include front-mounted bike racks, and bikes are allowed during daylight hours only; for safety, they are not permitted after dark as they may obstruct headlights. All buses are ADA-compliant and wheelchair accessible, supporting safe and inclusive transportation for all riders. The Avon East--Red Line runs every 30-minutes between 6:30am to 10:00pm. sources.title: Bay Metro
evidenceExcerpts: Skip to content Home Services & Fares Routes & Schedules Rider Info Business Opportunities Inside BMTA Contact Sunset Sunset It is our mission to provide high-quality public transportation service to the residents of Bay County. This means operating a system that is economical and efficient; a system safe for both employees and the public. It also means providing transportation service which is reliable and predictable; service which is responsive to community needs and respectful of the property and rights of all individuals. While it is our goal to serve all county residents, the needs of seniors and the disabled will be assigned a special priority. evidenceExcerpts: Skip to content Home Services & Fares Routes & Schedules Rider Info Business Opportunities Inside BMTA Contact Services & Fares Fixed-Route Service Fixed Route Passengers with Disabilities Guide Ten fixed routes service much of Bay County, including the communities of Bay City, Essexville, Kawkawlin, Linwood, Pinconning, Auburn, and University Center (home of Delta College and Saginaw Valley State University). The routes run on 1-hour headways (schedules) departing from the Central Bus Station (CBS) located at 1124 Washington Avenue in downtown Bay City. Monday through Friday, the first buses depart from the CBS at 6:15 am and the last bus departs at 5:15 pm. On Saturdays, eight fixed routes run with the first buses departing the CBS at 9:15 am and the last bus departing at 5:15 pm

The $772 million plan includes a property tax increase to help pay for community safety programs, fair employee pay, better services, and long-term projects like parks, roads, and water systems. What’s in the Budget The total budget is about 8% higher than last year. Les usagers doivent s’inscrire auprès du service mobilité de la DLVA. Le bus reste toujours accessible aux personnes à mobilité réduite grâce à son aménagement adapté pour la montée. Début 2023, la Communauté de Communes a investi dans un véhicule neuf financé par la publicité de commerces locaux. Sur le réseau Sète Agglopôle Mobilité, le transport est gratuit pour les enfants de moins de 10 ans. En bus, votre titre de transport doit être validé à chaque montée, même en correspondance (lorsque vous utilisez plusieurs lignes) et est valable 1 heure. Accomodations Service and comfort animals may accompany passengers. Pets are allowed to be transported with you, provided they are placed within a carrier. Carry-On packages: We can only accommodate packages that can be carried on board in a single trip and safely stowed under the seat or on your lap while on the vehicle. Child Restraints: As a courtesy, each bus has a child safety seat, but it is recommended that you bring your own in the event that this courtesy one is not available. ccessible It’s important to us that individuals with physical disabilities or require physical assistance are provided accessibility with the public bus system.
